quote.text: The money is in the follow-up. Same leads, same offer — the only variable left is how fast and how many times you reach out.
quote.author: Alex Hormozi

schedule: No calls booked. Check GHL/Calendly for overnight bookings first thing, then run the follow-up blitz on every unbooked lead before noon.
focus: Capital One sent two 'Action required: Your payments returned' notices yesterday afternoon — a returned payment, not just a statement reminder. Confirm whether that card funds your $35/day FB Ads and clear it today, because a declined card pauses Meta delivery and kills your only live lead channel.

Still 0 closed from 27+ leads at a ~$17 CPL — about $460+ spent on people who never booked, and zero prospect replies in the last 48 hours. Run a personal text-and-call blitz through every unbooked GHL lead today with a direct booking link. Traffic is fine; follow-up speed and volume is the only lever left.

Verify today's FB ad is delivering and the 9 AM auto-post hit all 16 groups. At $35/day with no closes you can't afford a silent delivery failure burning budget, and the group posts are your only free top-of-funnel.
gmail_summary: No prospect replies or warm conversations in the last 48 hours. The one item that matters: Capital One sent two 'payments returned' notices yesterday — flag this against the card funding FB Ads before delivery is affected. Everything else is routine: a vague '14-day trial extension granted' from acct-mgmt.com, a Shopify order link, plus Michaels, LinkedIn, Upswing Poker, and Bank of America/Merrill promos. Nothing needs a reply.
gmail_items: 🔴 Capital One — Action required: Your payments returned (sent twice)
✓ No prospect emails — the rest is routine personal noise
